description: This Java class 'QueueValidator' extends 'DataValidator<Queue>' and provides validation logic for Queue objects, including checks for queue creation, updates, and data integrity constraints within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: QueueValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that validates Queue objects for creation and update operations, ensuring data integrity and business rules compliance.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates the creation of a new Queue, checking for duplicate name and topic within the tenant.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to an existing Queue, ensuring the Queue exists and its name and topic are not changed.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of Queue data, including tenant isolation, name, topic, polling interval, partitions, processing timeouts, and strategy configurations.
